instruction: Please disable the automatic window resizing in VLC when opening videos. I want to keep the window size fixed regardless of the video dimensions.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
